top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 212 RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 20 were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scan of FEC request-for-additional-information (RFAI) letters and Form 99 filings received from October 20 onward found 212 filings. All 212 were covered in a prior edition, so there are no new RFAIs, Form 99s, terminations or red-flag keyword hits to report.

The check for voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more could not run. The FEC's itemized-transactions query timed out (HTTP 504), so this edition cannot say whether any such rows exist. The deterministic sections that follow cover new independent expenditures.

sections.headline: $1,288,094 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 5 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $1,288,094 in all. Largest target: James Talarico (oppose, $488,500). 1 shared-vendor overlap between a campaign and a supporting super PAC.

blocks.text: Same vendor, campaign and super PAC

items: Technicolor Political was paid $5,500 by Angela Nixon's campaign (FL Sen.) this cycle and $337,500 by TD PAC in new spending supporting the candidate.

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/20/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (form FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 20, 2026 through the October 23, 2026 PM edition. 212 filings in window, 212 already reported, 0 new.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The Schedule A fetch for voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more failed with HTTP 504 (query timed out), so that section could not be checked this run.

apod.title: Andromeda in Southern Spring
apod.caption: Looking toward the north from Mullion, New South Wales, Australia, the Andromeda Galaxy never gets more than a few degrees above the horizon. During the southern hemisphere spring, Andromeda is highest in the sky around midnight though.
